title: Tech Note: The 4D Business Kit v2.x IP Component

historical_commentary.text: 4D Business Kit, 4D Insider, 4D Pack, and the Yapee plug-in are all long-discontinued products specific to this era of 4D's e-commerce and component tooling, making this note's specific technical content obsolete; 4D's component architecture and e-commerce integration approaches have been completely reworked in the decades since, and any modern 4D e-commerce solution would be built from scratch using current web/ORDA/REST tooling rather than this legacy stack.
related_updates: 4D Business Kit, 4D Insider, 4D Pack, and the Yapee plug-in are all discontinued legacy products with no current equivalents
4D's modern component architecture (introduced in later versions) completely superseded the 4D Insider-based component model referenced here
